evidence.quote: Fees are separate from the fund, subject to court approval, and any reduction should benefit the class.
Open with a substantial class fund, a modest separately paid fee subject to court approval, no clear sailing

summary: Plaintiffs raised fee terms first, as part of initial proposals that also included class relief. The transcript does not show sequential fee negotiation before class relief was set, any tradeoff between fees and recovery, plaintiff self-interest, defense leverage of fees, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
